name: Benediction
descriptionTemplate: Salvador gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: Place 1 {Sanctuary of Mercy} into hand. At the end of the turn, gain [Power:Arg2] {STR}.
lore:
An invisible plague silently brings endless suffering and madness.

The bishop cannot sleep at night, deeply pained by his inability to alleviate people's suffering.

"O Merciful Creator, save them. I am willing to bear all their pain and sorrow."

Thus, the All-Father bestowed "Benediction" upon him, allowing him to wield the Tablet inscribed with Scripture, performing acts of relief.

At turn end, gain [Power:Arg2] {STR}. {Crimson Furnace} accumulated by {He Who Protects} and {Blessed are the Bones} +25%, and when {Liberation} is selected for {End of Suffering}, every 1% of Max HP consumed from Furnace improves Final DMG from 2% to 5%.
